text:
Maeve (Finance): Heads-up — vendor FreshMeter sent renewal invoice FM-4509 with a weird 'monthly smoothing adjustment' that increases the bill vs raw usage. Can someone check? :confused:

Nina (Billing): CSV snippet they attached: 
line_id,sku,units,unit_price,subtotal,adj_code,adj_amt
A1,model.tokens,125000000,0.00002,2500,,0
A2,commit_offset,100000000,-0.00001,-1000,,0
A3,monthly_smoothing,25000000,0.00006,1500,SM-01,1600

Nina (Billing): A3 subtotal 1500 but adj_amt 1600, and units*unit_price = 1500.0 exactly. Their adj increases net billed; contract says adjustments must not raise net beyond raw calc.

Owen (Platform): Do we use that vendor's models in production? If smoothing depends on request distribution we can dump a token-time series for them to reproduce.

Jules (Procurement): I'll draft an email asking for: per-SKU rates used, definition of SM-01, sample calculation reproducing invoice, and native CSV with clear pre/post rounding. CC billing/legal.

Sam (Legal): Add clause request: require deterministic rounding rules and per-invoice sample calc. If they refuse, propose capped overage or 6mo pilot.

Iris (BillingBot): Invoice FM-4509 flagged: anomaly_score=0.78. Recommended action: manual review + vendor clarification.

Maeve (Finance): Thanks — please include PO FM-4450 and request reissued invoice if math doesn't reconcile. Keep me posted.

Jules (Procurement): Drafted and ready to send in 30m. Will paste here for review.
